# ABRI

> ABRI is a Malaysian business network for public company discovery, SSM verification evidence, and peer endorsements.

Canonical website: https://abri.asia/

## Primary public resources

- [Business directory](https://abri.asia/directory): Browse and filter Malaysian business listings.
- [About ABRI](https://abri.asia/about): How verification and the business network work.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://abri.asia/faq): Claims, SSM verification, privacy, plans, and endorsements.
- [Contact ABRI](https://abri.asia/contact): Contact routes and support.
- [Ask ABRI](https://abri.asia/ask): Interactive questions about the platform.

## Entity profiles

Individual public company profiles use `https://abri.asia/business/{business-id}`. Their structured data and visible page content are authoritative for profile-specific facts.

## Crawl guidance

- The canonical business index is linked from /sitemap.xml.
- Member-only, account, recovery, claim-token, and administrative paths must not be indexed.
- Public source attribution, privacy, and licensing statements are in /privacy and the site footer.
